### God’s Judgment on Joash
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/gods-judgment-on-joash
Passage: 2 Chronicles 24:24
Points:
- Joash began his reign with apparent devotion and repaired the temple, but his faith never truly took root in his heart.
- Following the death of Jehoiada, Joash embraced idolatry and repaid his family's kindness by murdering Jehoiada's son Zechariah.
- Because the king and the nation abandoned God, the Lord delivered Judah's massive army into the hands of a tiny Aramean force.
- Left severely wounded after the battle, Joash was murdered in his bed by conspirators and denied burial among the kings of Judah.
- True salvation requires personal, enduring trust in God rather than relying on the faith of relatives or spiritual mentors.
